reason: Pre-inference inspection found the same tall chimney at image-left in both front and back, which would put it at inconsistent physical corners. Move only the back-view chimney to mirrored image-right while retaining the single-story Art Deco architecture.

visualReview.notes: Actually inspected the generated front/right/back triptych: one tall capped chimney now reads front-left, right-view rear and back-right. The old back-left chimney is gone and the parapet continues there. One occupied floor, pale stone corners, red brick, dark green windows and door, stepped front Art Deco ornament and entrance steps remain coherent. A small low roof vent remains distinct from the tall chimney. Reference semantics only; this is not model approval or pixel-identical preservation of the edited bitmap.
